Title: Tinglestripe vs ghoul retainer and concealed weapon

Messages.Author: Satrapa
Messages.Body:
Tinglestripe have 2 effect at different levels of mytherceria.
Does owner of Tinglestripe have to have mytherceria to use it (can
Ghoul Retainer use this weapon) or is mytherceria only required to
equip with it?

If usability of this equipment is set when equipping at what level can
it be used while equipped via concealed weapon?

Personally I think that it can be equipped by anyone but requires
mytherceria to use it but I'm not sure about it.
